ai_summary: Highway Infrastructure Limited has finalized a significant contract with the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for the operation and user fee collection at the Kozhinjipatti Toll Plaza, valued at approximately INR 28.69 Crores. This agreement is a material positive impact, set to generate substantial revenue and strengthen the company's highway infrastructure portfolio. A key ambiguity, however, is the stated '90-day execution period,' which creates uncertainty regarding the actual duration of the fee collection and the annualized financial impact.
